name: SellToken miner spot-priced reward payout
summary: The SellToken miner pays each matured setBNB position its daily BNB amount converted to reward tokens at the PancakeSwap router's spot getAmountsOut quote along WBNB -> USDT -> token, from the miner's own token balance. Attackers opened small positions through helper contracts, and a day later inflated the quote within one transaction by pushing token-heavy liquidity into the thin token/USDT pair, called sendMiner for millions of tokens, and sold them into the token/WBNB pair.
notes: Campaign: every miner token payout in a transaction not sent to the miner directly (Etherscan tokentx and txlist of the miner, full history): seven sendMiner claims through helper contracts by three attackers (0x00601294, 0x3c7ecdb9, 0x0000000000144b4f) on SELLC, HNC, TRDT and SHORT, from 2023-06-11 to 2023-06-26. The other contract-initiated transfers are setBNB liquidity adds (e.g. the anchor attacker's 0.001 BNB helper positions in 0x6dc47343). Direct EOA claims before the anchor peak at 4,834 SELLC and 7,741 TRDT against 3.08M SELLC per helper in the anchor; sibling miners from the deployer's other factories (0x76486cac, 0xd5de51c2, 0x594ac22e, 0x09824d9d) paid no rewards.

Loss at realised value (rule 12): the claimed tokens were all sold in the same transactions into their token/WBNB pairs, crashing them; each asset is the WBNB those pairs lost net of the attackers' own manipulation buys, priced by DefiLlama at block time.
